scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.test: npm test --workspace cloudflare-hub && npm test --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm run typecheck --workspace cloudflare-hub

DB.description: A D1 database for usage, quota snapshots, and encrypted provider credentials. Deploy to Cloudflare provisions it automatically.

CREDENTIALS_KEY.description: Required secret: generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. This key encrypts all provider credentials stored in D1; keep it backed up.

ACCESS_TEAM.description: Optional until Cloudflare Access is configured. Set this to your Zero Trust team name, for example `example.cloudflareaccess.com` uses `example`.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Optional until Cloudflare Access is configured. Set this to the AUD tag of the Access application protecting this Worker.
